content: {"praised":["Judd Nelson delivers compelling performance as Joe Hunt.","Story highlights greed and murder among wealthy Los Angeles elite.","Suspense keeps viewers engaged throughout the long runtime.","True crime narrative well written and well acted.","Themes of ambition and moral corruption explored."],"criticized":["Made-for-TV production feels inferior to theatrical films.","Length exceeds typical movie, over 3 hours.","Script lacks depth compared to other dramas.","Story feels derivative of other finance thrillers.","Tone inconsistent, mixing drama with unrealistic elements."]}
